_note: Macros per case type (Ruben, 20 October 2026). The case schema declares its macros (x-openregister-action with macro: true), so every case type would offer every one: Woo-verzoek afronden on an objection. `macros` lists the keys of the macros a case of this type shows on its AI-toezicht tab, in order; the case page's macros card reads it through nextcloud-vue `macrosFrom` (macros-per-record). A case type that lists none shows none. Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.28.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

macros.title: Macros
macros.description: The macros a case of this type offers, in order, by the key of the case schema's declared action. Empty offers none.
